subject: Privacy & Digital Rights
title: Immigration Data and Tracking
description: A fast breakdown of Immigration Data and Tracking for builders.

hook.text: Data from a school enrollment form is used to track down and deport a child's parents. It was never meant for that.

buildup.text: Immigration agencies access data from schools, hospitals, DMVs, and utility companies to locate undocumented people.

discovery.text: ICE purchased commercial location data from apps, bypassing the need for warrants or court orders.

twist.text: Fear of data sharing makes immigrant families avoid hospitals, schools, and emergency services — harming their children.

climax.text: Targeting vulnerable people with data collection doesn't just invade privacy — it destroys institutional trust.

punchline.text: School form to deportation order. Data travels.

quiz.question: How does immigration enforcement use of data harm communities?
options: Families avoid hospitals, schools, and services out of fear of data sharing
It only affects people who have committed crimes
It has no impact on service utilization
